title: ESTIMETR Guided Assistant and Strict Release Gates
description: เพิ่มผู้ช่วยการใช้งานแบบ contextual สำหรับผู้เริ่มต้น/ทำงานเร็ว และขยาย ESTIMETR mockup ให้ล็อกการข้าม project path, scale, evidence, approved price set และ document release อย่างชัดเจน.
scope: deterministic in-workspace Guided AI Assistant with beginner and fast modes
strict project-path, drawing/scale, take-off, price-set and document-readiness gates
workflow-policy unit tests, operating-policy documentation and official-source discovery record
private repository hardening with SHA-pinned GitHub Actions and Dependabot security updates
verification: desktop 1440×1400 and mobile 375×1200 visual review completed
security preflight, roadmap validation and diff hygiene pass
rollback: Return to tag v0.10.2-estimeter-github-confirmed. No migration, customer data, price source or document artifact exists in this UI-only release.
constraints: Navigation links only use internal routes or anchors; no new auth/payment behavior is enabled.
Mobile navigation remains keyboard-reachable and horizontally scrollable without hiding the enterprise quote action.
Sticky navigation must not obstruct target section headings.
This workspace is a non-persistent demo: it must not present sample prices, quantities or export approval as a live business record.
AI guidance is advisory only and has no write, price, approval or export authority.
